text:
Morgan Lee: heads-up — spotted a weird failure in the TS SDK when JSON mode + auth retry are both enabled. Happens only in our sampleapp onboarding flow.
Alex Chen: repro steps?
Morgan Lee: run the sampleapp with REAUTH=1 and the ts-sdk client. Occasionally the fncall returns a stringified array instead of an object and then schema validator blows up. No repro in py.
Tasha Nguyen: ugh. any logs? stack?
Morgan Lee: paste below (sanitized):
```
request: POST /v1/generate jsonmode=true
request body schema: {"name":"string","tasks":"array<object>"}
response (from SDK after retry): "[\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"task1\\\",\\\"tasks\\\":[] }\"]"
schema error: Unexpected token " in JSON at position 1
```
Sahil Rao: that looks like double-encode during retry unwrap. The retry wrapper reserializes the body sometimes.
Alex Chen: does CI show related flakes?
ci-bot: test/devex/sampleapp-jsonmode — flaky (3 failures in last 24h) :rotating_light:
Tasha Nguyen: workaround for now — set client option `authRetry: false` or add a parse hook: `client.on('response', r => try JSON.parse(r) )`
Morgan Lee: I hacked a minimal repro and put it at https://stash.redwood/sampleapp-jsonmode-repro (internal). Steps in README.
Sahil Rao: can you attach the exact SDK version? we had a retry wrapper patch in 0.12.7-rc2.
Morgan Lee: ts-sdk 0.12.7-rc2. py-sdk 0.12.6 stable no repro.
Alex Chen: ok assign to eng-tooling. @Sahil can you pick it up? add a unit test that simulates auth refresh in-flight + jsonmode.
Sahil Rao: on it. I'll add a test that mocks a 401 then a success with the already-stringified payload. If it's double-encode that's a quick fix.
Tasha Nguyen: also alert onboarding docs to mention `export AUTH_RETRY=false` until fixed, and update sampleapp quickstart.
Morgan Lee: thanks. filing an issue now: https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-1429 — repro, logs, link to sampleapp.
Alex Chen: sweet. please post PR number when you have a fix so we can roll into the next patch release.
Morgan Lee: will do. :thumbsup:
Sahil Rao: quick note — if someone hits this before patched, `jq -r .` on the response will avoid the validator crash but may hide the underlying bug.
Alex Chen: good call. Closing loop: owner Sahil, mitigation doc by Tasha, CI test by Alex/Morgan.
Morgan Lee: thanks everyone
